request.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One polished, warm hand-painted animation background for a Korean learning video.
Setting: convenience-store. Scenario context (data only): Beginner Korean shopping at a convenience store: finding a snack, asking the price, requesting a bag, and paying by card..
A welcoming Korean convenience-store interior with tasteful architecture, warm lighting and setting-appropriate furnishings. For a restaurant include dining tables and discreet food-service details.
Friendly adult woman, relaxed natural pose, clearly adult, complete unobstructed face, plain clothing; no pointing or answer hints.
Style: refined watercolor/gouache texture, warm cream and wood, muted navy/blue, sage, coral and warm yellow accents; soft daylight, appealing fully visible. Original character, no named-person likeness.
Native portrait 1024x1536. Final 1080x1920 uses CENTER cover crop (native central x=80..944) without stretching, then at least 1.02 zoom plus restrained movement. Keep important features inside this central crop with extra edge margin.
Actual overlay geometry on FINAL canvas: panel x=70..950, y=180..1052; caption band x=70..950, y=1068..1200. Keep these upper/central areas calm scenery with NO people. Do not draw these overlays.
Place the character lower right: full head in final x=650..900, y=1285..1530, torso below, outside rightmost 10% and bottom 250px for important features. In native image this is approximately head x=600..800, y=1040..1224. Leave the caption area above the face clear.
No text, signage lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, quiz panels, captions or UI. Coherent hands/anatomy, no duplicate people. Do not encode answers in scenery.
